description: Parse a US ACH file in the NACHA fixed-width format (94 characters per record) and check it: record order and nesting, entry and addenda counts, the entry hash, debit and credit totals at batch and file level, the block count and padding, routing-number check digits, transaction and service class codes, and field formats. Returns who originates the file, the batches with their calculated totals, and each problem with its line and column range. Account numbers are always masked in the output. Checks the published file format, not the full Nacha rulebook or one bank's extra requirements.

file.description: The ACH file as text: 94-character records separated by line breaks, or one unbroken run of characters.

name: ach_file_validate
title: Validate a NACHA ACH file
